title: Joint witness coding
goal: Construct normalized distributions describing each whole Fourier set with a controlled expected root and gate-label cost.
metric: Best proved expected total witness cost divided by influence, with the class and all residual terms stated.
roles: Construct finite queue and forest codes
Compare globally normalized mixtures of root odds
Find label-cost obstructions on addressing and tribes
Reconstruct normalization and Gibbs proofs independently
Transfer a successful code to F02 and F03

title: Correlated gate assignment
goal: Choose coordinate-to-gate assignments jointly so used-gate and overlap-congestion charges improve on coordinatewise read-number bounds.
metric: Proved bound for E[used-gate cost + allocation congestion] divided by influence on an explicitly defined class.
roles: Prove or refute dimension-independent congestion bounds
Connect assignment bounds to complete F01 witnesses

title: Rare-root amortization
goal: Pay sparse-root rarity and scale-selection costs without replacing a necessary logarithm by a bounded local constant.
metric: Smallest rigorously bounded global rare-root residual per unit of consumed influence.
roles: Combine the root bound with F01 normalization

title: Rank-free references
goal: Replace dependence on the number of coordinate orders by a global spectral reference that uses Boolean structure.
metric: Dependence of the proved entropy coefficient on order count, width, or another explicitly defined structural parameter.
roles: Construct references beyond total desirability orders
Search functions forcing large rank cost
Identify a route from structured references to unrestricted functions

title: Restriction charge
goal: Bound the total actual entropy cost of a genuine physical restriction tree with one conserved influence budget.
metric: Proved cumulative restriction cost divided by consumed ordinary influence, including the leaf term.
roles: Test bent and rare bad-split examples
Find a new restriction-closed class beyond the baseline

title: Block stopping rules
goal: Find useful proper blocks or stopping rules controlling conditional block spectrum entropy while ending at certified leaves.
metric: Largest explicit family admitting a terminating block rule with a uniform conditional-entropy charge.
roles: Choose physical blocks from dependence structure
Combine blocks with threshold or affine leaves

title: Erasure and synergy
goal: Exploit signed Boolean constraints to control erasure entropy or its downward logarithmic residual; retain high-order parity dependence.
metric: A new valid bound for the downward spectral-edge log functional with every residual explicitly identified.
roles: Use Boolean convolution on spectral edges
Transfer a bound through the known erasure reduction without calling the reduction new

title: Reveal correlation budget
goal: Verify and attack the decaying-threshold reveal-policy correlation integral in the current Brain, retaining the forced-information refund and separating entropy transfer.
metric: Best valid bound or counterexample for the exact weighted total-correlation integral after its definitions and source are pinned.
roles: Reconstruct the reveal dynamics and admissibility
Prove a drift inequality with the refund
Certify the integration and boundary terms
Determine exactly what additional entropy-transfer theorem would imply FEI

title: Boolean convolution
goal: Use the exact signed XOR autocorrelation identities of Boolean spectra in a dimension-independent entropy estimate.
metric: Strongest proved entropy or downward-edge inequality under the full Boolean constraints, and sharp counterexamples to relaxations.
roles: Develop algebraic identities from f squared equals one
Derive exact certificates for candidate inequalities
Connect the signed estimate to F07 or F04

title: Decision-tree covariance
goal: Improve the dependence on read count for decision trees by controlling covariance or whole-path costs beyond the known square-root bound.
metric: Proved dependence on k in the read-k decision-tree entropy coefficient, with prior-art comparison.
roles: Reconstruct the best known read-k proof
Prove a logarithmic or sharper intermediate estimate
Test whether the mechanism can escape the representation parameter

title: Selector interference
goal: Extend selector closure beyond the proved fresh-selector, orthogonal-neighbor or uniformly positive-selector-energy cases, paying coherent interference explicitly.
metric: Largest class and smallest explicit interference penalty for which a strong selector inequality is proved.
roles: Audit entropy and normalization under overlap
Connect a valid interference budget to F12 or F14

title: Two spectral addresses
goal: Reconstruct the Brain's conditional-product spectral-address results and settle the next two-address case with a valid constant; do not reuse the already refuted constant two.
metric: Best proved constant or exact obstruction for the precisely sourced two-address class.
roles: Map which larger selector classes the result would cover

title: Biased weighted thresholds
goal: Extend the strong product-measure entropy inequality from symmetric thresholds to genuinely weighted thresholds, with constants uniform in biases and arity.
metric: Largest weight class with a uniform corrected FEI-plus coefficient and explicit composition consequence.
roles: Identify the weighted pivotal concentration obstruction
Audit deterministic inputs and corrected entropy
Transfer a valid gate theorem to read-once weighted-threshold formulas

title: Shared-variable composition
goal: Develop entropy transfer for repeated selector variables or low-energy shared-data compositions beyond the new multiplexer closure, without assuming false product entropy subadditivity.
metric: Proved loss per overlap/depth parameter, or a normalized representation theorem that removes one parameter.
roles: Connect the result to full-scope gate representations

title: Sparse extremal structure
goal: Use activation-preserving reductions to identify additional structural hypotheses that genuinely simplify FEI; rarity or small influence alone is insufficient.
metric: A proved structural theorem or a new exact asymptotic H/I family that changes a live route.
roles: Identify a non-equivalent restricted core class worth proving

title: Exact finite search
goal: Search Boolean truth tables and structured families for violations of new intermediate inequalities, preserving physical influence and using certified logarithmic comparisons.
metric: New certified extremizer, smallest counterexample, or explicitly exhaustive new domain for a live candidate claim.
roles: Return minimal counterexamples to the proposing team

title: Asymptotic stress families
goal: Turn promising finite obstructions into all-dimensional families and determine whether they refute a route, a fixed constant, or full FEI.
metric: A rigorously proved growth law for the targeted cost-to-influence ratio.
roles: Analyze parity, bent, and tensor constructions
Prove limiting ratios and quantify all parameters
Give every live route a matched asymptotic stress test

title: Certified optimization
goal: Convert useful numerical patterns into symbolic inequalities, exact witnesses, or rigorous optimization certificates rather than enlarging brute-force checks without a theorem target.
metric: New certified parameter region, dual bound, or exact inequality directly feeding a full-FEI route.
roles: Measure whether the certificate resolves a previously unpaid term

title: Independent proof reconstruction
goal: Independently reconstruct the strongest new candidate arguments, identify hidden hypotheses, and prove or refute their missing bridges; formalize only the parts where it reduces concrete risk.
metric: A repaired or refuted pivotal lemma, independently reconstructed full proof, or faithful checked formal core.
roles: Rebuild proofs without using their conclusion
Formalize critical finite or induction steps where feasible
Issue source-pinned mathematical reviews to F20

title: Full-FEI synthesis
goal: Combine compatible proved ingredients into a dimension-independent FEI proof or a rigorous unbounded-ratio Boolean family; maintain the exact remaining gap and reallocate stalled work within FEI.
metric: Number and strength of genuinely unpaid universal obligations in the best complete proof outline, with a precise dependency graph.
roles: Construct the global proof from accepted lemmas
Audit whether reductions only rename full FEI
Verify theorem-sized candidates with independent teams
Maintain the campaign summary and authorized publication routing
